skills.name: olko-factory-run-supervision
skills.description: Rules to read the summary of one finished Software Factory run and find its bottleneck and optimizations: the summary fields, how to rank cost and time, and which changes to propose (cheaper tier, fewer rounds, a script instead of an LLM step, fewer questions). Use when you supervise or review the cost and time of a factory run. Triggers: 'supervise factory run', 'factory run bottleneck', 'optimize factory run', 'olko-factory-run-supervision'.

skills.name: olko-factory-workflow-yaml
skills.description: Rules for the Software Factory workflow YAML in factory/workflows: how an Olko agent's steps map to phase groups, nodes, edges and conditions, which engine operations exist, how a workflow names its sources, and how to validate it. Use when you write, update or verify a factory workflow from an Olko agent or skill. Triggers: 'factory workflow', 'map agent to yaml', 'update factory yaml', 'verify factory workflow', 'olko-factory-workflow-yaml'.
